raw:
```sql
SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating)
FROM main."Player_Attributes" pa
WHERE CAST(pa.date AS DATE) <= '2013-12-25'
  AND pa.overall_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND pa.date = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.date)
    FROM main."Player_Attributes" pa2
    WHERE pa2.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
      AND CAST(pa2.date AS DATE) <= '2013-12-25'
  );
```
